feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 31 August 2026 9:41pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 31 August 2026 at 9:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north of Scotland, as high pressure over Spain extends a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West or Northwest 3 or 4, increasing Southwest 4 or 5 overnight, then becoming 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Isolated showers develop tomorrow morning, then become scattered in the north later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 to 5, increasing Southerly 4 or 5 occasionally 6 overnight into Wednesday, veering Southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Showers, then rain spreads from the west overnight into Wednesday, clearing to isolated showers in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.
